map.抽到重复条目怎么处理: What To Do If a Duplicate Is Drawn
map.：话术库条目有限且每次抽取相互独立，小库容配大数量时重复概率上升；需要不重复时把: The script library has a limited number of entries and each draw is independent, so a small pool with a large count raises the duplicate probability; when you need no duplicates, set the count below the library size and draw in batches, or remove duplicates manually before rolling out.

map.抽取是严格等概率的吗？: Is the Draw Strictly Equally Likely?
map.页面用随机比较器排序后取前 N 条实现抽取，取到每条的概率并不严格相等；日常练习: The page sorts with a random comparator and takes the top N entries, so the probability of drawing each entry is not strictly equal. It is fine for daily practice but not for a formal draw that requires equal odds.
map.为什么有时抽到重复条目？: Why Do Duplicate Entries Sometimes Appear?
map.每次抽取相互独立、不排除已抽过的条目，因此小库容配大数量时重复概率上升；请分批抽: Each draw is independent and drawn entries are not excluded, so with a small pool and a large count the duplicate probability rises; draw in batches or deduplicate manually.
map.话术库能自定义吗？: Can I Customize the Script Library?
map.当前使用页面内置的通用标准话术库，暂不支持导入自定义话术；可先在本工具中挑出骨架: The tool currently uses the built-in general standard script library and does not support importing custom scripts; you can pick a skeleton here first and then replace it with your own wording.
